# Odoo

Open-source ERP and CRM platform for business management, including sales, accounting, inventory, and project management

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/odoo/.

## Actions

- **Get Bank Statement Result** (read-only): Retrieve parsing results for a previously submitted bank statement.
- **Get Expense Extraction Result** (read-only): Retrieve parsing results for a previously submitted expense document.
- **List Databases** (read-only): List all available Odoo databases on the server.
- **Parse Applicant Resume**: Submit a resume/CV document for OCR parsing and data extraction via Odoo Extract API.
- **Parse Bank Statement Document**: Submit a bank statement document for OCR parsing and data extraction via Odoo Extract API.
- **Parse Expense Document**: Submit an expense document for OCR parsing and data extraction.
- **Parse Invoice Document**: Submit an invoice document for OCR parsing and data extraction via Odoo Extract API.
- **Get Applicant Parsing Result** (read-only): Retrieve parsing results for a previously submitted resume/applicant document.
- **Get Invoice Parsing Result** (read-only): Retrieve parsing results for a previously submitted invoice from Odoo Extract API.
- **Odoo JSON-RPC Call**: JSON-RPC endpoint for Odoo external API calls.
